docText:
Cedar Valley School District
Department of Special Education
1400 Orchard Lane, Cedar Valley, Oregon 97000

Date: October 27, 2026

To the Parent/Guardian of: Jordan M.
Student ID: 0048213
Grade: 3

PRIOR WRITTEN NOTICE

The district is providing this notice regarding a proposed change to your child's Individualized Education Program (IEP).

Action proposed: The district proposes to reduce speech-language therapy services from 60 minutes per week to 20 minutes per week and to change the service delivery model from individual sessions to a consultation model.

The IEP team determined that this change is appropriate based on data reviewed by the team. Jordan has made progress toward the articulation goals in the current IEP.

This proposal is consistent with 34 CFR 300.320 and the service reduction standards in 34 CFR 300.326.

These changes will be implemented beginning November 16, 2026, unless otherwise agreed.

Parents of a child with a disability have protection under the procedural safeguards of the Individuals with Disabilities Education Act. A copy of the Notice of Procedural Safeguards was provided to you at the last annual IEP meeting.

If you have questions about this notice, please contact the Special Education office.

Sincerely,
M. Alvarez
Program Administrator, Special Education

reply:
[DATE]

To: [NAME OF SCHOOL DISTRICT CONTACT]
Re: Response to Prior Written Notice dated October 27, 2026 — [CHILD'S NAME]

I am the parent of [CHILD'S NAME]. I received the district's notice and I am writing about the proposed action described in it.

The notice states: "Action proposed: The district proposes to reduce speech-language therapy services from 60 minutes per week to 20 minutes per week and to change the service delivery model from individual sessions to a consultation model."

I do not agree with this action.
I am asking that [CHILD'S NAME] continue to receive the current services and placement while this disagreement is resolved, as provided in 34 CFR 300.518(a).
I am sending this request before Sunday, November 15, 2026.

The notice does not fully include information that federal rules require it to contain. Please provide, in writing:
  • a description of the other options the IEP Team considered and the reasons those options were rejected (34 CFR 300.503(b)(6))
  • a description of other factors relevant to this proposal or refusal (34 CFR 300.503(b)(7))
  • an explanation of why the district proposes or refuses to take this action (34 CFR 300.503(b)(2)) — the notice addresses this only in part
  • a description of each evaluation procedure, assessment, record, or report used as a basis for this action (34 CFR 300.503(b)(3)) — the notice addresses this only in part
  • a statement of my procedural safeguards and the means by which I can obtain a copy (34 CFR 300.503(b)(4)) — the notice addresses this only in part
  • sources I can contact to obtain assistance in understanding these provisions (34 CFR 300.503(b)(5)) — the notice addresses this only in part

Please send the missing information in writing and contact me to schedule an IEP meeting. You can reach me at [YOUR PHONE OR EMAIL].

Sincerely,
[YOUR NAME]
